taneycomo.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.

biteOfDay: On Taneycomo, rainbows and holdover browns respond well to light presentations during low morning flows. Table Rock bass are staging on deeper points, gravel flats, and offshore brush as they pack on weight ahead of winter. Recent patterns show consistent catches when anglers match the generation and use natural colors in the clear water.
tip: Insider tip: Take advantage of the low early flows on Taneycomo. Drift or wade seams and current breaks with a 1/16-oz marabou micro jig (black, sculpin, olive with orange head) or a #18-20 zebra midge under an indicator on 2-4 lb test.
